decision: Integrate reviewed upstream changes with independent opt-in controls and retained personal behavior
personal_adjustments: Eight independent controls defaulting off for index labels, hardware digit and space selection, prediction dismissal, digit swipes, toolbar docking, candidate reversal and letter-only punctuation positioning
Restore the existing llm_space_commit_prediction preference and preserve its stored value
Use an explicit digit-swipe candidate action with literal fallback instead of a NUL-prefixed text protocol
Reject non-ASCII digit swipe selection and preserve input when selection is unavailable
Clamp main glyph scaling in collapsed remaining-space bands
Reject all non-finite cursor anchors and floating candidate positions
Restore the full 2dp geometric glyph gap; verify exact placement separately from density-dependent font rasterization

covers: immediate main-label drawing and layout convergence

graph_analysis.result: impact and complete structured all/compare change analysis performed
graph_analysis.limitation: Graph results are a lower bound; some scope extraction and dynamic dispatch paths are unresolved. Regression validation supplements the graph.
